svg.title: Bitwise Parity Verification Process
svg.desc: Walking backward from the selected-token log probability to the first numerical difference. Trainer scoring, inference prefill and inference decode begin with the same inputs and weights.
svg.text: START AT THE OUTPUT · TRACE BACKWARD TO THE FIRST DIFFERENCE
RECORD THE OPERATION'S COMPLETE NUMERICAL PROGRAM
one row · one reduction · one state update
ONLY AFTER EQUALITY · TEST A CHANGE AND COMPARE AGAIN
